propositions: Gerrit Verified lane takes workflow definition from target branch but checks out the change's tree, causing gate steps added on main to run against older changes that lack the script file

Gate steps running repo scripts without if-present guards fail with exit code 2 (file not found) when the script is absent from the checked-out tree, producing false Verified -1 votes indistinguishable from real gate violations
Nine unguarded gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml's golden-path job must be wrapped with an early-return guard to skip with a log line when their script is absent
All guarded gate steps must retain the ability to fail the build when the script is present and detects a real violation
A structural guard should detect when Verified lane jobs run repo scripts without if-present guards, preventing future instances of this defect class
